test: Test 7: full TCAFF with filtered on-board clusters (thresholds on member count, cluster radius, member height)
method: As test 5 (MNO on saved B0 maps + release temporal filter at every step, 3 repeats). Cluster nodes as in tests 4-5 (sigma_G 0.30, epsilon_G 0.50, Arun weight x0.25). B0 and B0+KO are taken from test 5.
onboard_clusters: test-1 candidates (w <= 0.5, 0.08 <= h <= 0.6, |z - z_robot| <= 0.35), single linkage 0.7 m, radius <= 1.0 m, at most 10 members, plus:

configs.B0+KB3RH: members >= 3, cluster radius >= 0.30 m, median member height h >= 0.20 m
configs.B0+KB4RH: members >= 4, cluster radius >= 0.30 m, median member height h >= 0.20 m

threshold_origin: chosen after inspecting on-board cluster features against GT identity on this recording (share of real clusters 0.82 / 0.84 / 0.92 vs 0.50 unfiltered); exploratory, no held-out data
decision_rule: as test 5: improves on B0 if mean Acc exceeds B0's by more than B0's range over repeats AND wrong first decisions do not exceed B0's; accepted wrong modes (> 2 m or > 15 deg) are reported alongside
